messages.text:
At 16¢ that's mid-range — workable for the H15 Dual at $999, ships November 14. People buy it for the block shot and steady sats while it runs.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
love the setup, however, its an expensive solution as an integrated 2 for 1 miner. Better options out there. Just my two cents.

Fair point — the dual is a convenience buy. If it's sats per dollar you want, the Magic Miner 40T is our best value: $799, 40 TH/s at 650W, about $75 a month at 16¢, ships November 21. Same block shot, cheaper per terahash.

Want me to put one in a cart?
No thank you. Better options on eBay right now buying older ASIC miners adding third party software. Thanks and always a big fan of Helium Deploy!

Appreciate that, and thanks for the kind words.

Before you go, one thing: what's the used-ASIC setup you're comparing against — what does it get you that a new unit doesn't?
Much higher hash rate with better electrical efficiency.
Makes sense on paper. Where would a used unit like that actually run for you — garage, basement, somewhere you'd hear it?

Nice — that changes the math completely.

Last one: with solar covering the power, what would make you buy new instead of used — quieter, warranty, firmware support?
none of the above. Thanks - over and out
Thanks for the straight answers — good luck with the solar rig.

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Harlo H15 Dual numbers for where you live.
